intro: Ecuador packs coast, Andes volcanoes, Amazon rainforest and the Galápagos into a small country.

chapters.title: Avenue of the Volcanoes
text: Two lines of volcanoes run through the Andes, including Cotopaxi and Chimborazo. Because of the Earth's bulge at the equator, Chimborazo's summit is the farthest point from the centre of the Earth.
East of the Andes lies the Amazon; west, the coast and Guayaquil.

chapters.title: The Galápagos
text: About 1,000 km offshore, the Galápagos have giant tortoises, marine iguanas and blue-footed boobies found nowhere else.
